SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT KEY_3 AS LEGACY_GR_NO, KEY_1 AS LEGACY_PO_NO, KEY_2 AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ FROM KII_PO_KEPTRXL WHERE TRIM(KEY_9) IS NULL AND DOC_NAME='GRDOWN' ORDER BY KEY_3,KEY_1, KEY_2
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'KA' AS SITE, 'PETA' AS BUYER, NVL(STATUS,' ') AS STATUS, NVL(LEGACY_PO_NO,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_NO, NVL(LEGACY_PO_SEQ,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, NVL(BUYER_ITEM_NO,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, NVL(CURRENCY_CODE,' ') AS CURRENCY_CODE, NVL(UNIT_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE, NVL(GR_QTY,0) AS GR_QTY, NVL(GR_AMT,0) AS GR_AMT, NVL(REPLACE(GR_DATE,'-',''),' ') AS GR_DATE, NVL(LEGACY_PR_NO,' ') AS LEGACY_PR_NO, NVL(LEGACY_GR_NO,' ') AS LEGACY_GR_NO, NVL(LEGACY_GR_SEQ,' ') AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ, NVL(DELY_TO_LOCATION,' ') AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, NVL(RO_QTY,0) AS RO_QTY, NVL(RO_AMT,0) AS RO_AMT, NVL(REMARK,' ') AS REMARK FROM KII_PO_KEP_RCV_V WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' AND LEGACY_GR_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' ORDER BY LEGACY_GR_NO,LEGACY_GR_SEQ, LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ
UPDATE KEP_GR01 SET KEY_9 = 'Y', KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') WHERE TRIM(KEY_9) IS NULL AND DOC_NAME='GRDOWN' AND LEGACY_GR_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$'
